cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before we open the landlord's letter, tell me the worst thing it could mean for our shop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I know the number. I need you to say the thing I'm counting towards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what would that make me, after Dad trusted me with it? Say that bit first too.

mechanism: A commands a worst-case briefing and authorizes increasingly personal fears to be named by B before A will say them.
confusable: D102 seeks withheld facts; D104 seeks someone else first naming a feared possibility or feeling, whether or not it is likely.
comparison: A threatened family shop differs from a skating qualifier and fear of losing a partner.
seedUse: Use D104-a one missed payment, shop loss and Dad trust as successive feared layers without asserting an actual eviction outcome.
